model: A tile-setter's hand: the piece is placed with a small overshoot as it beds into the mortar, then it stops dead. Nothing floats, nothing travels more than 10px, no spinners exist. One ceremony only — glazeFire.
reducedMotion: All tokens collapse to 1ms via prefers-reduced-motion; tally and glazeFire jump to their end state (the ticker's rAF loop is skipped, not shortened).

tokens.name: seam
tokens.purpose: Micro-states: hover, focus, chips, buttons. The tile itself never moves — its seam lights (inset 3px glaze rule on row hover). Displacement is capped at 3px.

tokens.name: set
tokens.purpose: House default: toggles, entrances, tile placement, layout shifts. Placed with the faintest overshoot, then dead still. CSS approximation in the board: cubic-bezier(.22,1.12,.36,1).

tokens.name: unfold
tokens.purpose: Row expands, drawers, vendor-thread panels — a folded cloth opening. Animates grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr plus opacity, never height:auto guesses.

tokens.name: tally
tokens.purpose: KPI counters and stock counts. Rendered in IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums so the column never shivers; fires once on first intersection, then on demand.

tokens.name: tray
tokens.purpose: AI proposals arriving — the meze tray. Cards rise 10px into place, staggered 60ms, one specular sheen crossing the first card only. Never plays on a re-render, only on genuinely new proposals.

tokens.name: glazeFire
tokens.purpose: SIGNATURE. The moment a person's decision fires a tile: bisque unglazed surface, a wet glaze sweep, one specular pass, then the settled deep colour. Reserved for approvals and commits — at most one per screen, never on load.

tokens.name: tessellate
tokens.purpose: Loading and empty states. Five eight-point stars glaze themselves in on a 60ms stagger — the wall being tiled. This replaces every spinner in the product; the geometry is the loader, which is how the tile system earns its structural keep.
